data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting loss is primarily driven by the strengthening of reserves, primarily in the casualty classes, partially offset by the recognition of additional written premium.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Closure of the 2018 Year of Account via RITC into the 2021 YOA (and related reserve transfers) which affects reserve comparability and can distort development patterns.

prior_year_events.event_name: Loss Portfolio Transfers with Syndicate 33 (2019 and prior YOAs)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Two LPTs completed with Syndicate 33 covering 2019 and prior YOAs; these transactions added legacy liabilities/assets affecting reserves for those years.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2024 the syndicate held gross claims outstanding of GBP 449.383m. During 2024 management reports an overall movement driven by a strengthening of reserves, primarily in casualty classes. The syndicate notes monitoring for inflationary impacts and continues to hold an allowance in IBNR for potential future inflation effects. The claims development tables and technical reserves are impacted by prior RITC and LPT transactions (including the 2018 RITC into 2021 and LPTs with Syndicate 33 for 2019 and prior), which distort direct extraction of an aggregate gross prior-year movement from the triangle; no single explicit gross prior-year movement figure is provided in the technical movement note.
raw_causal_phrases: the strengthening of reserves, primarily in the casualty classes
At the end of 2024, no material impact has been identified although an allowance continues to be made within the IBNR for potential future impact.
The prior year underwriting loss was primarily driven by write off of reinsurance bad debt and strengthening of reserves, partially offset by the recognition of additional written premium.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single-line gross prior-year reserve movement (aggregate) is reported. The gross claims development triangle is materially affected by RITC and LPT transactions (notably the 2018 RITC into 2021 and LPTs from Syndicate 33 for 2019 and prior), which distort diagonal comparisons; therefore a reliable aggregate gross prior-year development amount could not be calculated from the published tables. Narrative explicitly states reserves strengthened (especially casualty) but does not quantify gross PYD.
